subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should reasoning presentation be a portable agent-level preference with channel rendering, a Telegram-owned channel setting, or remain fixed to avoid another configuration surface?
rationale: Current code centralizes reasoning text formatting while Telegram owns transport rendering, and repository policy requires explicit intent before adding config/default surface or moving presentation policy across that boundary.

options.title: Portable Presentation Contract
options.body: Add a small typed presentation preference resolved centrally, with channel plugins mapping supported styles and falling back to italic.

options.title: Telegram-Only Setting
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned style setting and leave other channels on the shared fixed format, accepting channel-specific behavior and future divergence.

options.title: Keep Fixed Formatting
options.body: Decline new configuration and improve the single default format, such as adopting a more readable portable blockquote representation everywhere.

recommendation.title: Portable Presentation Contract
recommendation.body: Add a small typed presentation preference resolved centrally, with channel plugins mapping supported styles and falling back to italic.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history across the shared reasoning paths and prior issue-level product review.
